notes: Six fixed descriptive situations. No coefficient fitting or promotion. Repeated opponents do not imply a rivalry. Prior closing lines may be missing; unknown is not false. Rates use classified regulation plays, exclude flagged penalties/kneels/spikes; no garbage-time or opponent adjustment. Sack denominator is classified pass attempts plus sacks, not all dropbacks. Runs exclude sacks and unclassified fumble plays; short yardage is third/fourth down with 1–2 yards needed. Team-unit indicators are not individual blocking grades or injury effects.
